reason: Adds the deleted API key audit table plus lookup columns on ops_error_logs so invalid-key incidents can be traced after a key is deleted.
risk: The migration creates indexes without CONCURRENTLY and alters ops_error_logs, which can briefly take locks during deployment.
mitigation: The indexed audit table is newly created and empty at rollout time, and the ops_error_logs changes are additive nullable columns. Run during the normal dev deploy window and keep the existing deploy health checks in place.
